B"H

# Phase 2 — Twenty Improvements After Attacking The First Architecture

The Awtsmoos gives expansion through Chesed and boundary through Gevurah in every instant of light;
Awtsmoos.com must therefore make universal possibility bounded, inspectable, cacheable, and right.

1. Resource envelopes must remain deliberately small; optional capabilities belong under named sections so a basic resource is cheap to serialize and easy to understand.
2. Type identifiers require namespaces and semantic versions or compatibility metadata so two domains cannot accidentally redefine `post` or `document`.
3. Type definitions need explicit lifecycle states: experimental, active, deprecated, retired, with replacement links and migration notes.
4. Schema recursion and deeply nested input require depth/size limits so generic rendering and validation cannot be weaponized into resource exhaustion.
5. Presentation hints need a strict allowlist of semantic primitives; no arbitrary class names, selectors, HTML, script, or CSS values from untrusted API data.
6. Query capability must advertise supported operators per field/type instead of accepting a universal unrestricted query language against every backend.
7. Query execution requires server-side maximum depth, page size, projection width, relationship traversal, aggregation cost, and timeout budgets.
8. Capability discovery is advisory UI metadata; authorization must always revalidate action permission at invocation time.
9. Action descriptors need stable IDs separate from labels so localization and copy changes never break clients.
10. Actions must declare safe/idempotent/retryable semantics explicitly; clients must not infer retry behavior from HTTP method alone.
11. Destructive actions need confirmation semantics describing whether simple confirmation, typed phrase, preview, or irreversible warning is required.
12. Mutations need optimistic concurrency tokens/revisions where races matter; generic editor must surface conflicts instead of last-write-wins silently.
13. Bulk operations need partial-success receipts and item-level errors rather than one global failure state.
14. Error resources need safe public metadata separate from privileged diagnostics so developer inspection cannot leak secrets to ordinary users.
15. Provenance must distinguish claims from verified facts; generated/inferred metadata should carry confidence/source status rather than masquerading as authored truth.
16. Transformation receipts need deterministic/nondeterministic flags and hashable input/config snapshots so reproducibility claims are honest.
17. Renderer selection needs deterministic precedence and diagnostics so plugins cannot unpredictably shadow each other.
18. Generic rendering must impose recursion, collection-length, string-length, media-size, and expansion limits; huge resources need lazy/paged disclosure.
19. Shared CSS foundation must be opt-in via a root attribute/class initially, then expanded only after runtime evidence; a global reset across thousands of specialized pages is too dangerous.
20. Migration must prove at least one real existing domain end-to-end before adding broad adapters; abstractions that only pass synthetic tests are not yet architecture.

## Resulting Corrections

- Universal means extensible contracts, not unrestricted behavior.
- Server remains authoritative for permissions, validation, query cost, and mutation concurrency.
- Generic UI is a safe fallback with budgets and diagnostics, not a replacement for every specialist experience.
- Shared styling begins scoped, measurable, and reversible.
- Existing API payloads stay stable until an adapter proves equivalence.

## NEXT_ACTION

Write the improved Phase 2 architecture around these constraints, then perform a third critique focused on evolution, caching, transport, mobile, accessibility, and operational failure.
